text.zh-CN: 贲门约4×4 cm溃疡肿物；初次活检坏死及小深染细胞，考虑小细胞未分化癌。
text.en: An approximately4×4 cm ulcerated cardia mass; initial biopsy showed necrosis and small hyperchromatic cells, considered small-cell undifferentiated carcinoma.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。

text.zh-CN: 贲门和小弯胃壁不均增厚，肝内多发约5–6 mm强化不均低密度灶，性质待明确。
text.en: Irregular cardia/lesser-curve wall thickening and multiple approximately5–6 mm heterogeneous liver lesions of uncertain nature.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。

text.zh-CN: 术中肝结节冰冻为转移癌；切除小圆细胞肿瘤，假菊形团，侵至浆膜，胃小弯淋巴结及肝转移。
text.en: Liver nodule frozen section showed metastatic malignancy; a small-round-cell tumour with pseudorosettes invaded the serosa with lesser-curve nodal and liver metastases.

text.zh-CN: Keratin±、CK8−、ChrogA+、Syn+、NSE+、CD99−、Ki-67−、S100−；原作者称胃神经外胚层瘤。无EWSR1等分子检测。
text.en: Keratin±, CK8−, ChrogA+, Syn+, NSE+, CD99−, Ki-67− andS100−; the authors called it gastric neuroectodermal tumour. NoEWSR1 or other molecular study is supplied.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。
source.en: Source report, case presentation; de-identified factual summary with educational dialogue.

text.zh-CN: 近端胃大部切除后接受依托泊苷和顺铂，严重胃肠道反应后拒绝再次化疗，约4个半月后死亡。未载毒性分级、直接死因或分子复核。
text.en: After proximal gastrectomy, etoposide/cisplatin caused reported severe gastrointestinal intolerance and further chemotherapy was declined. Death was reported about4½ months later; toxicity grading, immediate cause and molecular review were absent.

text.zh-CN: 胃小圆细胞恶性肿瘤并肝转移；精确现代分类需病理复核
text.en: A gastric malignant small-round-cell tumour with liver spread; precise modern classification requires pathology review

feedback.zh-CN: 转移已由组织证实，但旧名称及不一致免疫表型不能自动等同现代Ewing诊断。
feedback.en: Spread has tissue confirmation, but the historical label and discordant immunophenotype do not automatically establish modern Ewing classification.

text.zh-CN: 任何Syn阳性都能确诊Ewing肉瘤
text.en: AnySyn positivity establishes Ewing sarcoma

feedback.zh-CN: 神经内分泌标志物不具这种特异性。

text.zh-CN: Ki-67阴性证明所有肝结节良性
text.en: NegativeKi-67 proves all liver nodules benign

feedback.zh-CN: 肝结节病理证实转移，且该增殖结果应核验。
feedback.en: Liver histology confirms metastasis and the proliferation result needs review.

prompt.zh-CN: 制定今天治疗计划前最关键是什么？
prompt.en: What is central before planning contemporary treatment?

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。
need.en: First review the relevant history and source records available in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 胃肠与肉瘤病理团队复核原切片、完整免疫及必要分子检测，并结合转移范围
text.en: GI/sarcoma pathology review of slides, full immunophenotyping and indicated molecular tests, integrated with disease extent

feedback.zh-CN: 准确分类关系到系统治疗，不能照抄旧方案。
feedback.en: Classification determines systemic therapy; a historical regimen cannot simply be copied.

text.zh-CN: 仅凭旧文标题立即按固定Ewing方案用药
text.en: Use a fixed Ewing regimen from the old title alone

text.zh-CN: 因为病灶小就忽略已证实肝转移
text.en: Ignore proven liver spread because lesions are small

feedback.zh-CN: 转移性质不由尺寸否定。
feedback.en: Small size does not negate metastatic histology.

prompt.zh-CN: 严重胃肠道化疗反应和死亡能证明什么？
prompt.en: What can severe chemotherapy intolerance and death establish?

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。
need.en: First review the relevant history and source records available in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 需重视耐受性与支持治疗，但不能据单例确定某方案有效或无效、或死亡直接由化疗造成
text.en: Tolerability and supportive care matter, but one case cannot establish efficacy or attribute death directly to chemotherapy

feedback.zh-CN: 原文未给详细毒性分级、死因机制或替代方案比较。
feedback.en: Detailed toxicity grading, mechanism of death and comparative treatment evidence are absent.

text.zh-CN: 拒绝后续化疗证明患者不值得继续照护
text.en: Declining further chemotherapy means no further care is warranted

feedback.zh-CN: 仍需支持、症状缓解和共同决策。
feedback.en: Support, symptom relief and shared decisions remain necessary.

text.zh-CN: 生存约数月证明该旧病名已经分子确诊
text.en: Survival for months molecularly confirms the old diagnosis

feedback.zh-CN: 预后不能取代病理分型证据。
feedback.en: Prognosis does not replace classification evidence.

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 以通俗语言说明主要判断、下一步及至少一项具体未知，询问理解和顾虑；不得声称未载明的疗效或预后。
judgeGuidance.en: Use plain language for the interpretation, next step and at least one case-specific uncertainty; check understanding and concerns, without asserting undocumented benefit or prognosis.

knowledge.zh-CN: 先区分病史、检查和推论；指出不确定性。后续经过须在完成当前决策后查阅。
knowledge.en: Distinguish history, findings and inference, and state uncertainty. The subsequent course is reviewed after completing the current decisions.

conclusion.zh-CN: 原报告称胃PNET伴肝转移，但CD99阴性、神经内分泌表型及缺失分子证据要求保留现代诊断不确定性。
conclusion.en: The source labelled gastricPNET with liver spread, but negativeCD99, neuroendocrine phenotype and absent molecular evidence require modern diagnostic uncertainty.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 历史病名不自动等于现代分子分类。
keyReasoning.en: Historical labels are not automatically modern molecular diagnoses.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 标志物阳性与阴性都应结合形态和技术质量。
keyReasoning.en: Interpret positive and negative markers with morphology and technical quality.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 治疗不耐受须纳入共同决策。
keyReasoning.en: Include treatment intolerance in shared decisions.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例回顾不能证明因果或比较疗效。数字仅为原报告时点记录，不是实时监测；没有参考区间的数据不自行补区间。
boundaries.en: A single retrospective report cannot establish causality or comparative efficacy. Numbers are source time-point records, not live monitoring; missing reference intervals are not invented.
